mapper.update: UPDATE project_snapshot SET owner_user_id=#{owner},owner_name_snapshot=#{name},dept_id=#{dept},source_version=#{version}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE project_id=#{project} AND source_version<=#{version}

UPDATE workflow_task t JOIN module_instance m ON m.id=t.module_instance_id SET t.assignee_user_id=#{owner} WHERE m.project_id=#{project} AND m.finished=FALSE AND t.status='OPEN' AND t.node_id=m.current_node_id AND t.candidate_role='PROJECT_LEADER'
